exact_statement: Let g be any Boolean function on a finite uniform cube, m=ghat(empty)^2. Let D be a nonnegative subprobability with D(empty)=m and finite c=CE(P_g,D). Supply normalized S,Q with S>=D, Q(empty)>=m, and Q(T)>=gamma D(T) for every nonempty T, 0<gamma<=1. For every finite adaptive tree querying fresh physical coordinates per path, at any chosen subset of stopping leaves reset to the direct marginal of S with ONE final vacuum calibration to the actual child mean-square, using the explicit empty point law for constant children; all other leaves retain the full inherited direct marginal of Q. Expected spectral erasure debits plus all complete terminal cross entropies are at most c+(1-m^2)log2(1/gamma). More sharply the excess is at most log2(1/gamma) times the sum over retained leaves of physical reach times [(1-m)+m Var(g_leaf)]. An arbitrary continuation below a fresh frontier leaf, with further calibrations of the CURRENT inherited reference, is paid by the complete-reference chain and nonpositive calibration costs; retained old frontier leaves admit no-reset continuation. This supplies no influence-priced reference, no likelihood floor for arbitrary incoming profiles, and no repeated return to the ORIGINAL source marginal after intervening calibrations. Entropy units bits.
